title: Too many resumes miss *this* part ✍️
description:
If you aren’t getting call backs on your applications your resume needs to show more impact. What is impact? Displays of your skills at your last job. It’s a common mistake just to list a responsibility you held in your last position but by writing achievements with skills and metrics, that shows your value you can bring to this new role. #resumetips #resumetok #resumeadvice #interview #interviewtips #jobsearchtips
